type of previous placenta accreta spectrum
outcome: Clinical outcomes of subsequent pregnancies after conservative surgery for placenta accreta spectrum
Risk factors for adverse pregnancy outcomes (recurrent placenta accreta spectrum, cesarean scar pregnancy, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: 883 patients with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent conservative surgery at The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University between 2011 and 2019
finding: Conservative surgery for placenta accreta spectrum allows for subsequent pregnancies, but with an increased risk of complications like recurrent placenta accreta spectrum, scar pregnancy, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: This study investigated subsequent pregnancy outcomes in patients with placenta accreta spectrum who underwent conservative surgery instead of hysterectomy.
gest_age: Varied, including full-term, near-term, and second trimester
